**Install Packages/Library**
```{r Library}
library(readxl)
library(naniar)
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
```

**Descriptive Statistics/Data Exploration**

```{r missingness}
missingness_table <- miss_var_summary(ProjectC)
print(missingness_table) 

sum(tolower(ProjectC$TotalRadDose) == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE) 
sum(tolower(ProjectC$ECOG) == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE)


```

- total unknown radiation dose (could be considered missing?) = 41
- total unknown ECOG (could be considered missing?) = 14
- other than that, no missing covariate data

```{r splitting up vte, greater/less than 3 mos}

ProjectC <- ProjectC %>% mutate(vte_timing = case_when(
  Vte_status == 0 ~ "No VTE", 
  Time_vte <=3 ~ "VTE <= 3 mos", 
  Time_vte > 3 ~ "VTE > 3 mos"))

table(ProjectC$vte_timing, useNA = "ifany")
```

- split up VTE into greater than or less than 3 months, might be helpful for analyses?

```{r descriptive statistics}

desc_stat <- ProjectC %>%
  select(Sex, Age, MGMT, ECOG, EOR, TotalRadDose, Vte_status, Death_status, vte_timing) %>%
  tbl_summary(statistic = list())

print(desc_stat)
#frequency of categorical variables

desc_stat_bystatus <- ProjectC %>%
  select(Sex, Age, MGMT, ECOG, EOR, TotalRadDose, Vte_status, Death_status, vte_timing) %>%
  tbl_summary(statistic = list(), by = Vte_status)

print(desc_stat_bystatus)
#frequency of categorical variables by VTE status for fun

desc_stat_bytime <- ProjectC %>%
  select(Sex, Age, MGMT, ECOG, EOR, TotalRadDose, Vte_status, Death_status, vte_timing) %>%
  tbl_summary(statistic = list(), by = vte_timing)

print(desc_stat_bytime)
#frequency of categorical variables by VTE greater/less than 3 mos for fun

desc_continuous <- ProjectC %>%
  select(Time_vte, 'Time_death/censoring') %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ c(
      "{mean} ({sd})",
      "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1, # Rounds to 1 decimal place
    missing_text = "No VTE / Missing"
  ) %>%
  add_overall()

desc_continuous

```
